description: This file defines an interface class 'ISessionServerAppManager' for managing session server applications within the Rialto server manager component. It declares virtual methods for application lifecycle management, state updates, ping handling, and log level configuration.

classes.name: ISessionServerAppManager
classes.description: An interface class for session server application management, providing methods for initialization, state management, and communication.

methods.name: preloadSessionServers
methods.description: Preloads a specified number of session servers.

methods.name: initiateApplication
methods.description: Initiates an application with a given name, state, and configuration.

methods.name: setSessionServerState
methods.description: Sets the state of a session server identified by application name.

methods.name: onSessionServerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in session server state, identified by server ID.

methods.name: sendPingEvents
methods.description: Sends ping events with a specified ping ID.

methods.name: onAck
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment responses from session servers.

methods.name: getAppConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection information for a specified application.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for the session server application.
